notes.title: AVGN 8-bit LAUNCHES on October 23, 2025!
notes.notes: [h3]We are excited to announce that AVGN 8-bit will be releasing on [b]October 23, 2025[/b]! Get a sneak peak at even more gameplay and, for the first time ever, live action cutscenes featuring The Nerd himself![/h3][p][/p][h3]Check out the AVGN 8-bit Release Date Announcement Trailer here![/h3][previewyoutube="I0uO3xPU6II;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Experience the ULTIMATE NERD RAGE in[i] Angry Video Game Nerd 8-bit![/i][/h3][p][/p][h3]The modern version from [b]Programancer[/b], features an 8-bit style with live-action cutscenes, making it feel like you’re [i]playing [/i]an AVGN episode. Our friends at [b]Mega Cat Studios[/b] will also be producing an NES cartridge version. Both the modern release and the NES carts will be available for physical pre-order soon through [b]Limited Run Games[/b].[/h3][p][/p][h3]As The Nerd, blast your way through pixel-art-packed levels with zombies, mechanical skeletons, ghoulish reapers, and more. Grab upgrades, slide through obstacles, and take down bosses plaguing every level![/h3][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/94851127ca67b81f1754719fce2e23e5d112f56b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/52bac2ea34adaa78aa612c7083f7b37d14738700.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/7be486e191e35ea79f7812150a91c85a3a731899.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/3bb7884ae1084b9aa5a1759b0d3c46688f8aa2c3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/7777610554844d099038a3c766fef3814cfff1de.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/0772f33fafd0d5c8756eb899b34fb185224d58d0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/8477903ab477fc1970a3cea18da2fe3e9bf196a0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/5d9c21dfb57add03d61e385b6e9128030050508f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/09242f3daf472471551dac4cf459a10bcc4d3f01.png"][/img][/carousel][h3]We're excited to be releasing [i]AVGN 8-bit[/i] on [b]October 23, 2025[/b]![/h3][p][/p][h3]Be sure to follow Retroware's developer page to stay up-to-date on all our games, news, and more![/h3][h3][/h3][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/retroware/"]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/retroware/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Nerd Room at MAGFest!
notes.notes:
Our team had loads of fun at MAGFest this year showing off AVGN 8-bit! And looking back on the event, we wanted to share how we created the Angry Video Game Nerd set for our booth set!

First, we got measurements from the actual set! Then, we got to work gathering the materials we needed, followed by the painting, drilling, and all that stuff! We also had to go into Photoshop to digitally recreate every shelf of "games" on the booth design, supporting the printed games with floral cubes!

After testing the entire build at our warehouse, we were set for MAGFest! We unloaded everything, put the booth together, set up an NES in a cabinet underneath a CRT TV, and away we went!

Take an in-depth look into our process with this video--narrated by THE NERD himself!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fSt39ZymjNU

notes.title: Announcing a New 8-bit Adventure!
notes.notes:
The Angry Video Game Nerd is back in an all-new 8-bit adventure! Working alongside Mega Cat Studios—developers of Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit—Retroware is proud to announce its newest AVGN title: [i][b]AVGN 8-bit[/b][/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/2971b69daa204c2799f4950b9b0b6003bd048645.png[/img]
When a corrupted monstrosity threatens the world, The Nerd must throw himself into the digital hellscape to purge the menace! Set across multiple, authentically 8-bit levels, players will encounter monsters, ghouls, robo-skeletons and more as they traverse through nonlinear environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/a4de7b969cb4e8ecc9bf78cc6500758474f98fbf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/5dcfbd848e5f8094b0841a38992b80320e7819a9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/33f1f75e175b0e50021b116fe8adfff438a4a798.png[/img]

With enemies and familiar bosses taking on forms from the AVGN universe, The Nerd must battle against revamped versions of his past foes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/c8c97e10a6705cecfab1956422caba8cb70f6747.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/ade38114b7838790220ae8718bf4eb56e9380662.png[/img]

And to top it off, Retroware has partnered with Limited Run Games to release the game in physical editions for every console—including on the Nintendo Entertainment System (NES) as a cartridge! More info on these at a later date!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/a9f88db883963d9c09e6cb4e125a787e2a8ce4e1.gif[/img]

So get ready to bring back the ULTIMATE NERD RAGE in [i][b]AVGN 8-bit[/b][/i], releasing 2025 for all platforms—and the NES! Wishlist the game now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445490/Angry_Video_Game_Nerd_8bit/

Stay tuned for even more updates!
